title: Instrument the DODGE-013 warm-start control-rate comparison
doing: Prepare a separately owned K1-versus-K4 diagnostic successor from420. Require per-update KL and epoch KL/stop information, entropy, value loss, raw advantage/return/reward scales and valid within-episode action-switch counts/rates for both arms. Freeze telemetry definitions and test passive integration without training; any diagnostic campaign requires its own registration, review, resource qualification and explicit go-ahead.
expected: If the warm-start regression involves optimization or value/credit scaling, the K1 arm may diverge in KL/entropy/value/advantage trajectories before survival regresses. If those remain comparable, local planning, state distribution and representation remain candidates. Telemetry associations alone cannot identify a cause.

evidence.label: User-directed K1 track handoff; external worktree read-only
